The Rust library and Kotlin bindings come from [iroh-ffi 1.2.0](https://github.com/n0-computer/iroh-ffi/tree/66a8d619a4d791d458d582f312df6e0ab42bc541). Kompi uses the upstream library source, Android JNI bridge, generated Kotlin bindings, licenses and Android linker settings. The manifest builds only the Android shared library: it does not build the upstream CLI, language packaging tools or JavaScript workspace. The lockfile updates the native dependency graph independently of the host daemon. Run `cargo audit` in this directory to check it.

The [local postcard 1.1.3 source](../postcard/) is from crates.io (archive SHA-256 `6764c3b5dd454e283a30e6dfe78e9b31096d9e32036b5d1eaac7a6119ccb9a24`). Its manifest disables the default heapless backend; iroh uses the standard-library encoder. The serialization code is unchanged.
